newsitem.title: USA: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 109.1 March 14 wk.
newsitem.headline: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 109.1 March 14 wk.

text.p: The Economic Cycle Research Institute (ECRI) weekly future inflation gauge (FIG) rose to 109.1 in the week ended March 14 from a revised 108.8 the prior week, ECRI said.
Both the growth rates of real estate loans and industrial material prices rose, while the insured unemployment rate remained at an 8-year low of 2.0 percent, pushing the gauge higher, ECRI said.
"The FIG is now at its highest level since 1995 ... The advance in the FIG is continues to be fairly pervasive, and is getting increasingly pronounced and persistent," ECRI said.
